Prettier never reaches a fixed point on this input. An own-line comment run leading
an OBJECT-ADJACENT intersection member re-binds on every pass: pass 1 pulls the run
onto the `&`'s line and drops the member to a shallower indent
(`{ x: 1 } & /* c1 */⏎{ y: 2 }`), pass 2 carries the run back ACROSS the operator to
trail the previous member and collapses the boundary
(`{ x: 1 } /* c1 */ & { y: 2 }`). `printIntersectionType`'s first arm hugs a
both-objects boundary before `hasLeadingOwnLineComment` is ever asked, so the
comment's own-line-ness cannot hold the break that its position depends on. No
prettier-anchored claim file (output_prettier.*, audit_signature.txt, variants) is
expressible. The validator live-verifies this claim (rule F5). See README.md and
docs/conformance_prettier_ts_comments.md §Comment relocation.
